title: Asorɔkye a Ɛkyekyɛɛ Mogya mu
intro: Fa w’adwene bu nsuyiri kɛse bi a ɛreforo wɔ asase no so, Adaka bi a ɛsensɛn hɔ pintinn, ne ɔkra biako a wɔagyaw wɔ abɔnten denam paw so. Esiane sɛ wɔde mogya akyekyere saa onipa yi ama odiyifo bi nanso gyidi atew ne ho nti, ohyiaa ɔfrɛ a etwa to sɛ ɔmmra hyɛn no mu bere a nsu no reyɛ kɛse no. So wubetumi ahu onii ko a wɔpow no akyi?
clues: Meyɛ Allah nkɔmhyɛfoɔ akɛseɛ no mu baako asefoɔ, gyidie fie a mepaw sɛ mɛgyae.
Metraa ase wɔ Nsuyiri Kɛse no bere mu, bere a gyidi a wonni kataa asase no so te sɛ nsu no.
Mepowee sɛ me ne gyidifo no bɛforo Adaka no bere a me papa frɛɛ me no.
Mekaa sɛ mɛhwehwɛ guankɔbea wɔ bepɔw bi so de abɔ me ho ban afi nsu no ho.
Wɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ biribiara ntumi mmɔ wɔn ho ban mfiri Allah ahyɛdeɛ no ho saa Da no gyese mmɔborɔhunu.
Asorɔkye no bɛkaa me ma memee, na wɔka kyerɛɛ me papa sɛ menyɛ n’abusua trenee no muni.

Wɔtow no gu ogya a ɛredɛw mu esiane sɛ wɔabubu abosom nti

Ɔbodan mu a wɔdae mfehaha pii sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobeguan ɔtaa
trial.answer: Pow a wɔpow sɛ wɔbɛforo Adaka no na wɔahwehwɛ bepɔw bi sɛ guankɔbea

arabic: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌۭ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبْنِى مِنْ أَهْلِى وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
verse: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!" (11:45)
